# Hexagonal Table Organizer

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model for a hexagonal table organizer. It features honeycomb-style hexagonal compartments perfect for storing items like nail polish and other small objects that can be neatly stacked beside each other on a desk or vanity.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
